svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Triad Drift HUD - space combat (steady)
svg.text: 5% safe margin (96 px / 54 px) - guide only, not drawn in game
Reticle 32 px: dot + 4 ticks, always on
Hull = thick inner arc (r44, 5 px); white > amber > red
Signature power pip 34 px: ring = cooldown, glyph = button; solid squad colour = READY
Target bracket + health bar + distance sit ON the target
Off-screen hostile: filled red chevron on safe frame
Off-screen wingman: hollow chevron, squad colour
Squad strip 360x44, bottom-left. Active chip: 148 wide, name, top bar. Wingmen: 100 wide, 72%
Objective line 480x28, 70% opacity; expands to 720x72 for 3 s when it changes
First-use hint 380x36 (dashed: onboarding only, gone after first successful use; +0.66%)
lower middle stays clear: no cards, no telemetry, no key legend
